description.value: Accent Inns Vancouver Airport is a BC-owned family hotel near YVR that markets itself as the most bike-friendly hotel chain in the province through its dedicated 'Bike Love' program, which includes free bike rentals for guests. Located in Richmond with a free SkyTrain connection to downtown Vancouver, it is a practical base for touring cyclists arriving by air or passing through the Lower Mainland. It is the first hospitality chain in Canada to have all locations Rainbow Registered by the CGLCC, reflecting a broadly inclusive ethos.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the hotel is actively operating, with phone number (604.273.3311) and address (10551 St Edwards Dr, Richmond, BC) matching the OSM record. A dedicated '/about-us/bike-friendly/' subpage describes the 'Bike Love program' covering all Accent Inns locations and the main amenities list explicitly includes 'Bike friendly with free bike rentals'; the page rhetorically asks why a bike should 'stay in a dark, unfriendly storage locker,' strongly implying a structured, superior bike storage arrangement, though the subpage is truncated before full specifics are stated. Laundry facilities and free in-room Wi-Fi are confirmed via explicit amenity icons on the main location page, corroborated by OSM tags internet_access=yes and internet_access:fee=no.
concerns: The '/about-us/bike-friendly/' subpage is truncated in the cached content, so full details of the Bike Love program (specific storage type, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel with a confirmed web presence, matching contact details, and a dedicated cyclist amenities program — clear inclusion for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free bike rentals are explicitly listed as part of the Bike Love program. Hotel also offers a free airport shuttle, pet-friendly rooms, and a fitness room. Rainbow Registered (CGLCC accredited).
